sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Release and release group pages: the front cover from the sidebar now also appears at the start of the page heading, as an artist's photo, a label's logo or an instrument's drawing already did, so it stays in sight with the sidebar closed. A click, Enter or Space on it opens all of the release's Cover Art Archive images in the artwork viewer, starting at the front cover; they are asked for on that click only. The sidebar's own cover keeps MusicBrainz's link. Switches: "Sidebar picture: hover card and viewer" and "Sidebar picture beside the name".

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Link previews on an editor's profile, "Tags and ratings": the "view" beside Tags upvoted shows how many tags and genres they voted for and with how many votes, the most used first; a tag opens its own tag card. The "view" beside Ratings shows their ratings as their ratings page does, a few per kind with their stars; an entity opens its own card. The stars on MusicBrainz's page are links that change a rating, and the window never copies them. Downvoted tags have no preview.

sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Link previews on an editor's profile: every "view", "N%" and "View all" link of the statistics now has a card and a window. An editor's Open, Accepted, Auto-edits, Applied, Rejected, Failed and Cancelled edits, their Votes, and every edit search ("Last 24 hours", the edit types' percentages) open in the editing-history window, titled by what they list. An edit search is read again on every page load. The two "view list" links show the editor's subscribers (names, and how many are anonymous; a name opens that editor's card) and your authorized and registered applications (name, access, last token, digest authentication). An application's OAuth client ID or secret and its "Revoke access" link are never shown, and that page is never kept after a page load.
